report.summary: Meta's study of 2.4M comments found 97% resolved, 68% led to code changes. Concrete, inline suggestions from experienced reviewers on small diffs are more actionable. Google's Tricorder had ~50% fix rate for static analysis warnings. CodeRabbit lacks published data.
risks: Google general code review comment action rate not directly reported.
Data from a single company, may not generalize.

handoff.actionable_step: Ensure automated comments are concrete, specific, attached to code, and focused on small diffs to maximize action rate.
